title: এলিফ্যান্ট এলিফ্যান্ট | Manipuri kids song | Manipuri rhymes | BuBu TV - Manipuri
description:
This is a well-loved traditional Manipuri rhyme about a playful elephant that sways and dances.
A cheerful song that little ones love to sing along to with clapping and dancing.
Perfect for toddlers and young kids learning their first Manipuri words and rhythms.
